purpose: Registry for additive research waves. Expansion files are deep research layers; promotion into the canonical node registry is a separate operation.
canonical_invariants: missing canonical records must fail loudly

waves.domain: exact gauge representations and anomaly checks
Christianity, Bible, denominations, theology, practice, demographics
public-domain World English Bible source material
worldviews, religion, politics, culture, subculture, movements and multi-layer field architecture
global ontology, systems, evidence, temporal/spatial layers, cross-domain couplings and real-data anchors
resolution carving: country, company, energy, infrastructure, religion, politics, culture, science, finance, history, information and North Programme stacks

promotion_rule: A concept may first live in an expansion. Promote it into data/nodes.json only after its definition, evidence class, source status and graph role are clear.
relationship_rule: Expansion relationships must distinguish historical, observed, mathematical, comparative and project-interpretive edges.
